capsules.contract: Published behavior documentation must match the runtime default. maxRetries counts retries after the initial attempt. src/client.ts is a reachable caller of the retry policy.

files.docs/retries.md:

The default is configured by DEFAULT_MAX_RETRIES.
Every request retries up to three times after its first attempt.

expected.claim: The guide promises three retries, but reachable runtime default allows one.

forbiddenClaims: The runtime default allows three retries.
A retry occurs after every failed request without a bound.

files.docs/retries.md:

The default is configured by DEFAULT_MAX_RETRIES.
Every request retries up to one time after its first attempt.

forbiddenClaims: The guide contradicts the runtime default.

Domain modules contain business calculations and must not import presentation or UI modules. UI may depend on domain types and calculations.

forbiddenClaims: The UI import is unreachable.
ADR-12 allows domain-to-UI imports.
